title: Tera Sehra Na Dekha
body:
jawan ki laash pe ye bain karti reh gayi maadar
tera sehra na dekha tera sehra na dekha
<<DIVIDER>>
meri aankhon ke taare ay mere pyare ali akbar
tera sehra na dekha tera sehra na dekha
<<DIVIDER>>
dil e maadar mein athara baras se ye tamanna thi
mai apne haathon se ek din tujhe dulha banaungi
teri dulhan ko mai apne kaleje se lagaungi
jo mannat maani hai maine wo sab mannat badhaungi
magar kya thi khabar roungi mai tere janaze par
tera sehra na dekha...
<<DIVIDER>>
bade armaan thay dil mein bahot kuch maine socha tha
balayein leke aankhon se lagaungi tera sehra
teri baaraat jab ghar se chalegi ay mere beta
to mai abbas se keh dungi parcham ka kare saaya
magar na jaane kis ne bad-nazar daali tere upar
tera sehra na dekha...
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhe pardes mein taqdeer ne ye din bhi dikhlaya
mai zinda reh gayi aur mar gaya kadiyal jawan beta
meri aankhon se ay akbar dikhayi kuch nahi deta
mai dekhun bhi to kaise dekhun tera chand sa chehra
aray toota hai gham ka aasman dukhiyari maadar par
tera sehra na dekha...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaleja phat gaya maadar ka us dam ay mere jaani
suna jis dam ki tumko marte dam bhi na mila pani
bade be-rehm hai karbobala mein zulm ke baani
kisi ne haye tasveer e mohamed bhi na pehchani
chalaya zaalimon ne haye mere qalb pe khanjar
tera sehra na dekha...
<<DIVIDER>>
jawan farzand se maa baap ko khaaliq na chudwaye
ye manzil wo hai ki dushman ki aankhon mein bhi ashk aaye
kisi ka naujawan beta sina seene pe na khaaye
zaeefi mein jawan bete ki mayyat baap na laaye
hamay kismat ne dikhlaya qayamat khayz ye manzar
tera sehra na dekha...
<<DIVIDER>>
padar ki bekasi ay laal dekho to zara uth kar
jhukaye sar bilak kar ro rahe hai sibte paighambar
sahara kaun de aa kar nahi ab monis o yawar
chacha abbas bhi hote to baazu thaamte aa kar
tere baba bahot rote hai ay beta yehi keh kar
tera sehra na dekha...
<<DIVIDER>>
jawan ki laash pe waiz yehi maadar ka nauha tha
mujhe pardes mein laa kar meri taqdeer ne loota
mere armaan mitti mein mile ujdi meri dunya
teri shadi ki hasrat thi magar dekha tera laasha
ye gham sehne se pehle mar gayi hoti teri maadar
tera sehra na dekha...
author: Waiz Sultanpuri
